airport.name: Lemoore Naval Air Station (Reeves Field) Airport

summary: Lemoore Naval Air Station (Reeves Field) is a military airfield located in California's San Joaquin Valley, serving as the Navy's largest master jet base on the U.S. West Coast. The installation is home to strike fighter squadrons operating F/A-18 Super Hornets and is part of the strategic Pacific Fleet. Civilian use of the airfield is extremely limited, with the runway primarily supporting naval aviation training and carrier qualification operations.
faqs:
Q: Is Lemoore NAS open to civilian passengers?
A: No, this is an active military installation. Commercial passenger service is not available, and access is restricted to authorized personnel and their guests.

Q: What aircraft are based at Lemoore NAS?
A: The base primarily hosts F/A-18E/F Super Hornet strike fighter squadrons, along with F/A-18C Hornets and various training and support aircraft.

Q: How large is the airfield?
A: The facility features two long runways, with the main runway exceeding 13,000 feet, making it suitable for all military aircraft operations.

Q: Where is the base located relative to major California cities?
A: It is situated about 30 miles south of Fresno and roughly 200 miles southeast of San Francisco in Kings County.
transport_tips: Access to the base requires a valid military ID or pre-authorized visitor pass coordinated through a sponsor on the installation. The nearest commercial airport with scheduled passenger service is Fresno Yosemite International (FAT), located approximately 35 miles to the north. Rental cars and ride services are available in the surrounding towns of Lemoore and Hanford.
local_tip: Aircraft enthusiasts visiting the area can sometimes view jet operations from the approach end of Runway 32L near the public roads south of the base, though photography may be restricted near the perimeter fence.
